words.engDef: behavior that causes physical or mental pain to others; ruthlessness
words.example: The non-profit group fights against animal cruelty.

words.engDef: a voyage on a ship for pleasure, or travel smoothly
words.example: They spent their summer vacation on a luxury ocean cruise.

words.engDef: making a sharp noise when bitten; crisp
words.example: She loves eating fresh, crunchy organic apples.

words.engDef: to compress forcefully so as to break or injure, or a sudden infatuation
words.example: The machine was used to crush the discarded cardboard boxes.

words.engDef: a support used by an injured person to help them walk
words.example: He had to walk on crutches for a month after his surgery.

words.engDef: a clear transparent mineral, or high-quality glassware
words.example: The elegant chandelier was made of shining crystal beads.

words.engDef: the young of certain carnivorous animals, such as lions, bears, or foxes
words.example: The mother bear protected her young cubs bravely.

words.engDef: a symmetrical three-dimensional shape with six equal square faces, or mathematical power
words.example: She put three ice cubes into her fruit cocktail.

words.engDef: a long green fruit with watery flesh, eaten raw or in salads
words.example: She added some sliced cucumber to the green salad.

words.engDef: a signal for an actor or performer to do something, or a hint
words.example: The director waved his hand as a cue for the actress to speak.

words.engDef: a style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a country
words.example: The restaurant serves delicious and authentic Italian cuisine.

words.engDef: to prepare and use land for crops, or develop a skill
words.example: The farmers cultivate organic tomatoes in the greenhouse.

words.engDef: increasing or growing by accumulation or successive additions
words.example: The cumulative effect of smoking over years is severe lung damage.

words.engDef: having or showing skill in achieving one's ends by deceit; crafty

words.engDef: a cabinet or closet with shelves for storing household goods
words.example: Keep the tea mugs and ceramic plates in the cupboard.

words.engDef: to limit or restrain something, or the edge of a sidewalk

words.engDef: a regulation requiring people to remain indoors between specified hours

words.engDef: a strong desire to know or learn something, or a rare object

words.engDef: to form into a curved or spiral shape, or locks of curly hair

words.engDef: a system of money in common use in a country

words.engDef: the subjects comprising a course of study in a school or college
words.example: The school decided to add coding to its science curriculum.

words.engDef: a dish of meat, vegetables, or starch seasoned with hot spices
words.example: She cooked some spicy chicken curry for Sunday dinner.

words.engDef: a solemn utterance intended to invoke a supernatural power to inflict harm
words.example: The old witch cast a terrible curse upon the kingdom.

words.engDef: a continuously bending line without angles
words.example: The path curved gracefully through the green grassy valley.

words.engDef: a bag of cloth stuffed with feathers or soft materials, used for comfort
words.example: She placed several soft cushions on the sofa for comfort.

words.engDef: the protective care or guardianship of someone or something, or imprisonment

words.engDef: according to the customs or usual practices of a society or group
words.example: It is customary to exchange gifts during the festival.

words.engDef: the official department that administers and collects taxes on imported goods
words.example: The travelers had to pass through customs at the airport.

words.engDef: believing that people are motivated entirely by self-interest; distrustful
words.example: He has had a cynical attitude toward politicians since the scandal.
